evidence:
Structural ordering is supported, but empirical app ordering is unmeasured. Frozen tests/scoring.toml:1-11 uses zero-weight Render/Constraints gates, positive functional/polish/visual shares 0.6/0.2/0.2 and functional floor 0.05. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 computes a positive weighted mean and zeros only failed gates/floor; improving any fixed dimension cannot lower its reward. Both files were read and byte-compared equal to the frozen template (score.py SHA256 13de2b3885967e22aa13ded3bf33c354e3e741e85be871612c04e996eef5c04e). I executed that actual scorer main() using temporary synthetic suite JSON for 252 input states, including functional values 0, .0499, .05, .0501, .1, .5 and 1: 804 adjacent coordinate improvements yielded zero inversions. At full polish/visual, functional .05 produced 0 and .0501 produced .4301; all dimensions .5 produced .5 and all 1 produced 1. These are synthetic scorer outputs, not app grades. All 80 functional criterion weights (sum 45.25), six polish weights (sum 3) and six visual weights (sum 6) are positive; visual anchors increase with quality.

Adversarial inspection: a polished static/dead Run app is rejected by gates/render/judge.toml:25, while a working Run with browser-only saved data is rejected by gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-27. Thus those plausible weak apps cannot gain craft reward merely from appearance under the written gates. A conforming alternative with different selectors/API routes, server-rendered library records, or static rollback snapshots is accepted by constraints/judge.toml:25-29 and tests/app_context.md:18; optional gate preparation cannot turn missing Auto-run alone into a total failure (app_context.md:16). Functional/prompt.md:9-25 preserves separately observed outcomes and requires matching successful controls. No concrete task-specific inversion was demonstrated by these source challenges; they are not executed weak-app judge comparisons.

All 21 raw-evidence-index artifact SHA256 values matched current files; index SHA256 c5fb62b99ab425667d2346c5475436eaffa42d2f77d389d387edec1f3d3209b8. Its scope/limits explicitly say scripted product proof, no configured judge/model score, and distinguish source/layout timing. The history/post/runtime result scope fields also identify scripted golden proof; surface-results.json identifies scripted gate/polish evidence rather than configured judge scores. No runtime-evidence.json exists for this frozen run. Consequently there is no current-hash empirical ranking across the golden and deliberately weakened apps. Historical results for different source cannot fill this gap. Per current owner/user scope this actual-judge-only gap is deferred, but risk remains true and this row is not a Pass; shared scoring policy was not changed.
suggested_fix: Retain the deferred evidence gap. When actual judge measurement is undertaken, compare hash-bound golden and nested weakened variants under the unchanged configured verifier and preserve raw scores/logs; synthetic vectors and scripted golden checks cannot certify app ranking.
